content: Erot da Jems aŋakban kɨmagakwan Pita dam tebanon yɨpgut
Uŋun bɨsapmon kɨla amɨn madep Erot da paŋmuwukbi dɨwarɨ paŋupbal agɨt.
Aŋek Jon dakon padɨge Jems emat agak sɨba naŋ aŋakban kɨmakgɨt.
Erot da yaŋ aban Juda amɨn da nandaba tagɨsi aban Pita kɨsi abɨdagɨt. (Uŋun Bret Yisni Mɨni Dakon Jap Noknok Bɨsap Madepmon agɨt.)
Abɨdaŋek aŋkɨ dam teban yutnon yɨpmaŋek kɨlani ani do obip amɨn 16 kabɨ yopgut. Aŋek don Yapyap Bɨlak mudaŋakwan amɨn morap da dabɨlon abɨŋ gen pikon yɨp do nandagɨt.
Yaŋ nandaŋek Pita dam teban yutnon yɨpban kɨlani awit. Mani paŋmuwukbi da Piŋkop da Pita aŋpulugosak do bɨsit pi madepsi awit.
Aŋelo da Pita aŋpulugagɨt

Aŋwa Erot da Pita gen pikon yɨyɨpmɨ yaŋ do kalbi obip amɨn bamorɨ da bɨkbɨgon pagakwan kɨlani agɨmal. Pita uŋun nap teban bamorɨ baŋ aŋteban awit. Aŋakwa obip amɨn dɨwarɨ dam teban dakon yoma kɨla aŋek akgwit.

Aŋakwa uŋudon gɨn Amɨn Tagɨ dakon aŋelo kɨnda altaŋakwan teŋteŋɨ madepsi kɨnda dam teban yutgwan teŋteŋagɨt. Aŋakwan aŋelo da Pita gekgegɨkon tɨdaŋ aŋ yolek iyɨgɨt, “Gak tepmɨsi pɨdaŋ at!” Yaŋ iyɨŋakwan kɨsirɨkon nap teban bamot wɨtdal kɨŋ mibɨlɨkon magɨmal.
Maŋakwal aŋelo da Pita yaŋ iyɨgɨt, “Gak ɨmalgo paŋek kandap gwɨlgo yopmaŋ.” Iyɨŋban yaŋ gɨn aŋakwan aeni iyɨgɨt, “Ɨmal dubakgo paŋek nak nol.”
Yaŋ yaŋban Pita aŋelo yol aŋkɨgɨt. Mani aŋelo da uŋun asi asak yaŋ Pita dɨma nandaban pɨsagɨt. Butno pɨsaŋakwan dɨpmɨn yombem kɨnda kosot yaŋ nandagɨt.

Yaŋ nandaŋek kɨŋ obip amɨn kabi kɨnda yapmaŋek kɨŋ aeni obip amɨn kabi kɨnda gat yapmaŋek ain yoma tagɨt uŋudon kɨgɨmal. Uŋudon kɨŋakwal ain yoma uŋun iyɨ wɨtdal kɨŋakwan kokup papmon pɨgɨgɨmal. Pɨgɨ tɨmɨsok dɨ kɨŋek aŋelo uŋun Pita yɨpmaŋ dek kɨgɨt.
Kɨŋakwan Pita burɨ pɨsaŋakwan yagɨt, “O, kɨlɨ nandako pɨsosok. Amɨn Tagɨ da aŋeloni kɨnda yabekban pɨŋ nak aŋpulugak. Erot gat ae Juda amɨn gat da yo morap ak do nandaŋek nepgwiron naŋ aŋpulugosok.”
Yaŋ nandaŋek Jon dakon meŋi Maria uŋun da yutnon kɨgɨt. (Jon uŋun mani kɨnda Mak yaŋ iyɨwit.) Amɨn morapmɨ uŋun yutnon muwuk egek bɨsit pi awit.
Yaŋ aŋek egakwa Pita da abɨŋ waŋga agek yoma domon tɨdagɨt. Tɨdaŋakwan oman mɨŋat kɨnda mani Roda uŋun da yoma wɨtdal do aŋek opgut.
Obɨŋ Pita dakon tek nandaŋ burɨkon kɨsɨk kɨsɨk madepsi nandagɨt. Yaŋ nandaŋek yoma dɨma wɨtdalek tɨmtɨm yaŋek kɨŋ notni yaŋ yoyɨgɨt, “Pita yoma domon akdak!”
Yoyɨŋban iyɨwit, “Gak ŋugɨgɨ, Pita dam teban yutnon yɨgek arɨpmɨ dɨma apjak.” Yaŋ iyɨŋba sigɨn teban taŋek yagɨt, “Asisi, Pita yomakon akdak!” Yaŋban iyɨwit, “Aŋeloni da bo akdak.”
Yaŋ yaŋakwa Pita yoma sigɨn tɨdaŋban nandaŋek yoma wɨtdalek Pita kaŋek but morap awit.

Yaŋ aŋakwa Pita da gen dɨma yaŋek tayaŋgok yɨtni do kɨsirɨ da tɨlak aŋ yomgut. Aŋek Amɨn Tagɨ da damon naŋ wɨtdal aŋaŋ obɨk uŋun do yoyɨgɨt. Yoyɨŋ mudaŋek yoyɨgɨt, “Ji da Jems gat not kabɨ gat yo on altaŋ namɨk uŋun do yoyɨni.” Yaŋ yoyɨŋek Pita si abɨgɨgɨt.
Wɨsa dagokdo obip amɨn da Pita wɨsɨŋba mudaŋban but morap aŋek notni yoyɨŋ yoyɨŋ aŋek yawit, “Pita dukwan kɨk?”

Erot da Pita wɨsɨŋ koni do amɨn yabekban kɨŋ wɨsɨwit mani dɨma kawit. Dɨma kawit do Erot da obip amɨn Pita kɨla awit uŋun gen pikon yopmaŋek dapba kɨmotni do yoyɨgɨt. Erot kɨmakgɨt Don Erot Judia mɨktɨm yɨpmaŋek Sisaria kokupmon paŋkɨ egɨpgut.

Erot uŋun Saidon ae Tair kokupmon amɨn do nandaba yokwi tok madepsi aŋ yomgut. Uŋun kokup pap bamot japni uŋun Erot da mɨktɨm kɨla agɨron uŋudon tɨmɨkgwit. Mani Erot da japmɨ nandaŋek kosit sopsop aŋ yomgut. Yaŋ agɨt do kokup pap bamot kɨsi muwugek Erot dakon but mosak do kɨŋ koneŋ yaŋ yaŋek kɨwit. Kɨŋ mibɨltok Blastas do altaŋ ɨmɨŋek uŋun gat not aŋek don Erot do kɨwit. (Blastas da Erot dakon dɨpmɨn potpot yutni dakon kɨla agɨt.)
Kwa Erot da bɨsap kɨnda aŋ yomɨŋek uŋun bɨsapmon kɨla amɨn madep yɨk ɨmalni paŋek kɨla amɨn madep tamonikon yɨkgɨt. Yɨgek gen madepsi yoyɨgɨt.
Yaŋakwan amɨn da yaŋ tɨdaŋek yawit, “Uŋun amɨn dɨma, piŋkop kɨnda da yosok.”
Gen uŋun nandaŋek Erot iyɨ do nandaban wɨgakwan Piŋkop dɨma aŋkɨsigɨt. Yaŋ agɨt do Amɨn Tagɨ dakon aŋelo da uŋudon gɨn aŋakban namat da naŋ ɨba kɨmakgɨt.
Mani Piŋkop dakon gen da ɨreŋtaŋ kokupmɨ kokupmɨ kɨgɨt.
Banabas gat Sol gat pini Jerusalem wasɨp aŋek Jon mani kɨnda Mak uŋun abɨdaŋbal kɨsi Antiok kɨwit.
